comment: Every defect found while making a film and what stops it coming back (scripts/lib/defects.ts; checked by just defects). A new defect goes here when it is found, open if nothing guards it yet. Preventive entries were not seen here: their source says so.

defects.symptom: Wrong glyphs on screen: 回 a solid block, 己 drawn as 巳, 受 drawn as 要; every check passed and the delivered film carried them
defects.cause: The upstream ZCOOL XiaoWei file is wrong; coverage (cmap) cannot see a glyph drawn badly

defects.symptom: A character on screen missing from the font subset (Ó after a style upper-cased Córdoba; text added after just fonts)
defects.cause: The subset follows the literals in the sources, not text changed at run time or after the last just fonts

defects.symptom: Text too close to the edge of the frame
defects.cause: A style's margin plus a scene's offset crossed the 5 % line

defects.symptom: Captions one to two seconds behind the voice
defects.cause: Captions were timed by length, not where the phrase is spoken

defects.symptom: The same sentence three times at once: large on the page, in the caption, in the voice
defects.cause: No check compares a page's text with its captions; `shown` only helps where someone uses it

defects.symptom: A bright part of a plate pulls the eye from the text
defects.cause: Contrast is judged behind the glyphs only: a bright patch beside the text passes

defects.symptom: An export timed out with a message that looked like a fault of the film
defects.cause: Another session was rendering on the same machine

defects.symptom: Pixels that depended on the order frames were rendered in
A narration line said more than its source (a passive sentence given a subject it does not have)
defects.cause: A fact table's wording was written from memory of the source and then copied into the voice

defects.symptom: A commit that does not build
defects.cause: git add failed on a stale path and the commit went on with what was staged

defects.symptom: A film exported with a final mix made for an earlier cut
defects.cause: Nothing tied master.wav to the narration and timeline it was made for

source.note: preventive: a rule of the plan, not an incident

defects.symptom: Text too small on a phone, a landscape film in a portrait feed above all
defects.cause: Frames were only ever judged at desktop size

source.note: conclusion 6; the size in the feed is not documented by the platform

defects.symptom: Loudness or true peak off target after encoding, with the master in spec
defects.cause: Loudness was measured on the WAV, before AAC

source.note: preventive: not seen here; the idea is shuyuvideo's defect D08

defects.symptom: The MP4 handed over is older than the cut that passed the checks, in picture or in sound
defects.cause: validate, regress and the sheet render the page; nothing compared the delivered file with it

defects.symptom: A frame that depends on frames before it, or on the wall clock
defects.cause: frame(t) being pure is a rule in AGENTS.md; nothing runs frames out of order on a film, and the determinism spike ran once, on the engine

source.note: a gap found comparing with shuyuvideo's reverse-seek probe; no incident here
